redeem: Open Tower Defense X on Roblox and wait for the lobby to load.
Click the three dots button in the top-left corner of the screen.
Choose Codes from the menu that opens.
Type the code into the box and press Redeem. The Gold, XP, or powerups are added to your account.
notes:
Tower Defense X is a military tower defense game from the Tower Defense X Group, first released on Roblox in 2022 and still labeled as a beta. You and your team place land, air, and sea towers along the enemy path, upgrade them between waves, and try to stop bosses before they wreck your defenses. Winning matches earns Gold and XP, which unlock new towers. The current update is a crossover with Tower Battles II.

Codes here give Gold, XP, cosmetics like name tags, and powerups such as A-10 Strikes, Air Strikes, and supply crates you can call in during a match. Gold helps newer players most because it buys new towers, while powerups are best saved for hard waves and bosses. New codes show up in the official Discord for holidays, anniversaries, and big updates, and many last only a few days.

codes.reward: 1 A-10 Strike, 10 Cash Crates, 10 Health Crates, 5 Air Strikes, 3 Recon Drones, and 1 AC-130 Support

faq.q: Are Tower Defense X codes case-sensitive?
faq.a: The game's wiki says they are not, so upper or lower case both work. You still need the exact spelling and any symbols, so copying the code is the safest choice.

faq.q: When should I use the powerups from powerupzbutworks?
faq.a: The A-10 Strike, Air Strikes, and AC-130 Support are one-time powerups you call in during a match. Save them for boss waves or a wave that is about to break your defense instead of using them early.

faq.q: Why does the TDX25 code not work anymore?
faq.a: TDX25 was a limited code for the game's anniversary in November 2025 and it expired a few days later. Holiday and event codes in Tower Defense X usually have short lifespans.

tips: Towers come in land, air and sea types. Check where each one can be placed on a map before you plan your defense.
Join the game's group for bonus starting cash in your matches. Extra cash at the start lets you place stronger towers on the first waves.
Enemies and bosses can destroy your towers, so spread your defense out instead of stacking everything in one spot.
The Tower Battles II collab gives a 50% boost on battle pass tokens for a limited time. Play more matches while it lasts to get more out of it.
